scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The proof is analytic. A finite numerical check is only corroborative. The first public source date is the arXiv v1 submission date.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.not_proved: Optimality of the repaired constant; a classification when the endpoint derivative is zero; best rational approximation rates.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: Exact endpoint asymptotic for the clipped scheme and an explicit existence construction of equal-degree positive monotone rational approximants with nonnegative coefficients and inverse-linear error.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Targets on [0,b] that are twice continuously differentiable, nonnegative and nondecreasing, with a positive left derivative at the right endpoint.

title: Removing the clipping-rate barrier in positive rational Bernstein approximation
